problem: Two buses, $A$ and $B,$ drive toward a school. Bus $A$ travels south at a constant velocity of $30\,\text{ mph},$ while the bus $B$ travels west at a constant velocity of $40\,\text{mph}.$ If bus $A$ is $16$ miles from the school, and bus $B$ is $12$ miles from the school, how fast is the distance between the buses decreasing?

activity_context.topic_title: Calculating Related Rates Using the Pythagorean Theorem
